source: Binance USDT-M (fapi.binance.com, data.binance.vision): BTCUSDT open interest at each day’s open (the 23:55 UTC reading before it) and 7-day funding; alt share = share of USD open interest (contracts x mark price) among the top 50 alts by USD open interest with negative last funding, read live just after the day ends and stored on that day (approximates Coinalyze top-300)
